purpose: Teach: デリー/サウジアラビア/ユナイテッド/ダライ/家康/ジュネーブ/トロイ/台北

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがデリーに出張された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father took a business trip to Delhi.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Warm but searching — like looking at an old photograph. Slow, deliberate pace. Pause held between clauses.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、サウジアラビアの石油事業をご研究されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — and you did all that research on Saudi oil operations, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle correction wrapped in affection. Light, knowing laugh underneath. Warm drawl on 'dear.' She's reminding him, not correcting him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがユナイテッド航空で世界を旅された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father traveled the world on United Airlines.
lines.style: Same distant-memory tone. Slightly uncertain — caught between his own memory and hers. Softer attack. Trailing off on the airline name.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ダライ・ラマ来日時に講演を聴かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear, you attended that lecture when the Dalai Lama came to Japan, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, patient persistence. Affectionate edge — she knows something he's forgotten or misremembering. Slight upswing on the question, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが徳川家康の本を愛読された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father loved reading about Tokugawa Ieyasu.
lines.style: Voice drifting slightly. The same wistful melody, but quieter now — as if even he can hear the pattern repeating. Gentle, almost dreamy.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ジュネーブで国際会議に出られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear, you had tea brought in from Taipei, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial now. She's on the verge of gentle laughter — recognizing the lovely confusion. Tender close: soft fadeout on 'dear,' like tucking a blanket in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがトロイの遺跡に憧れた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father admired the ruins of Troy.
lines.style: Quieter now, more fragile. The wistfulness deepens — he's reaching further back, or perhaps further into the fog. Slow, careful articulation. Pause for breath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、台北のお茶を取り寄せられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear, you arranged to have tea sent from Taipei, didn't you?
lines.style: Tender close: soft, warm affection. No correction now — only gentle presence. Slow, deliberate pace. Voice like a hand on his shoulder. Fades into quiet acceptance.
